1.  Overview 
SEComEnabler enables you to integrate equipment int erface with SEMI equipment 
communication. The Equipment Interface Program (SEC omEIP), which is object-
oriented program generated by SEComEnabler, saves c ost for equipment integration 
and increases productivity.  
This document describes how to use SEComEnabler’s C omponent, such as 
SEComPlugIn and SEComPlugIn Extension, and how to m ake SEComEIP with these 
components.

2.3. Setting up Configuration with SEComClient 
Set up configuration information which is required for SEComDriver actions. 
The required information as follows  
- SMD file Path 
- Profile information (Driver Information, HSMS Mode etc) 
With SEComClient, you can set up Profile informatio n and the Profile information is 
stored in SEComINI.xml file. When SEComDriver is st ared, it searches Profile 
information by using Driver ID which is registered in SEComClient.  
 
* For further information for SEComClient, please refer to ‘User Guide’. 
 
2.4. Testing scenario with SEComSimulator 
You can test your SEComEIP program by using SEComSi mulator which is a 
simulation program acting as a virtual Equipment or  a Host. Set the information of 
virtual Equipment or Host with Configure Connection  of SEComSimulator, and then 
start to test EIP via SECS communication with the virtual Equipment or Host. 
 
* For further information for SEComSimulator, please refer to ‘User Guide’.

3.  SEComEnabler’s Components for Biz. Logic 
SEComEnabler uses three components: SEComCommon, SE ComDriver and 
SEComPlugin. Developers use SEComCommon.dll and SEC omPlugin.dll to implement 
EIP (Equipment Interface Program).  
 
3.1. SEComCommon 
SEComCommon is a set of SEComEnabler utilities. Thi s component provides various 
methods, such as data structure, interface, and str ing parsing, and gives read-
write access to many different kinds of data type, such as XML document, string, 
and extended data type. It also provides a common library for objects to execute. 
The library is the basis of all components of SEComEnabler.

* For further information for class, please refer to Appendix A: Components Table 
. 
 
3.2. SEComPlugIn 
SEComPlugIn is a component to manage SEComDriver. I t simply creates 
transaction messages which are sent from SEComEnabl er.SEComDriver class to 
user application.  
Developers are allowed to get access to SEComDriver only through SEComPlugIn.  
 
* For further information for class, please refer to Appendix A: Components Table 
. 
 
3.3. SEComDriver 
SEComDriver communicates with another SECS Driver. In this case, it sends or 
receives SECS or HSMS messages. When it is created,  an internal SECS protocol is 
created. While developing Biz Logic, you can access  to this component through 
SEComPlugIn.
